⚡ ELECTRONS – Code • Innovate • Inspire

We are a team of passionate EEE students from Sri Eshwar College of Engineering, combining engineering knowledge, software development, AI, and creativity to build innovative solutions for space exploration.

Our mission is to make space exciting and accessible to kids through technology! 🚀

We welcome enthusiastic teammates skilled in app development, AI/ML, UI/UX, web development, data science, astronomy, and creative problem-solving.

details:
SpaceBuddy – Explore. Build. Survive. Learn.

SpaceBuddy is an interactive 3D space academy that turns children aged 8–14 into junior astronauts!

Its main experience, Outpost Survival, challenges players to build and manage a Moon or Mars habitat. They must balance oxygen, water, food, energy and crew health while facing dust storms, radiation and unexpected emergencies.

Players can build solar panels, greenhouses, oxygen systems and radiation shields, collect resources and make critical decisions to keep their crew alive.

Beyond survival, eight interactive space missions teach rocket science, rover driving, gravity, navigation and planetary exploration. A multilingual AI guide, Cosmo, supports learning in English, Tamil and Hindi.

Powered by Three.js, JavaScript and NASA educational resources, SpaceBuddy makes space science fun through exploration, challenges and hands-on learning.

Don't just learn about space. Experience life as an astronaut!
